subject: Post-call: MaplePay security qualification & evidence next steps
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@maplepay.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-18T14:02:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call: MaplePay security qualification & evidence next steps

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our call and clear next steps so we stay aligned. Goal here is to validate Redwood's fit for MaplePay's regulated payments workload and make the evidence handoff for your security review as smooth as possible.

Key pain points you called out:
- Audit log retention: need 7+ years of immutable audit logs for transaction tracing and investigations.
- Data separation & tenant controls: banking customers require strict logical separation and access controls.
- Pen test and SOC 2 evidence: procurement requires SOC 2 Type II summary and an upcoming external pen test window.

What we heard as success criteria:
1) Provide a controls mapping (SOC 2 controls -> Redwood artifacts) by EOW (Oct 25).
2) Demonstrate audit log export sample and retention options (S3 retention + WORM) and a short config guide.
3) Confirm acceptable pen test scheduling and remediation SLAs.
4) Review DPA/legal redlines together and agree next steps for procurement.

Immediate next steps / owners:
- Redwood to deliver: SOC 2 controls matrix (Irene) — due Oct 25 — attachment: soc2-controls-matrix.xlsx
- Redwood SE to provide audit log sample + retention config (Jordan) — due Oct 21 — attachment: auditlog-sample.json
- MaplePay legal to share DPA draft (Alex) — Redwood to review and comment by Oct 22
- Plan a 30-minute follow-up to walk through the matrix and DPA (propose Oct 26)

Notes on evidence scope: we will scope artifacts at the control level (policy, process docs, config screenshots, logs, role mappings). If MaplePay needs full artifact copies (e.g., full SOC 2 report), we'll coordinate an NDA or redaction path.

Attachments: soc2-controls-matrix.xlsx (first draft)

Best,
Irene Choi
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

---

From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@maplepay.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: MaplePay Security Team <security@maplepay.com>
Date: 2026-10-19T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: MaplePay security qualification & evidence next steps

Irene — thanks for the tidy recap. This aligns with what our security and legal teams need. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Audit logs: the retention requirement is indeed 7 years, and we need tamper-evidence for the immutable retention (WORM or equivalent). Can you confirm if Redwood supports hardware-backed WORM or if we need to use a cloud provider feature?

2) Pen test: security would like to schedule a black-box pen test during Nov 8–12 or Nov 15–19. Can Redwood support one of those windows? Also please confirm a contact for remediation SLAs after the test (we typically contract 30 days for criticals).

3) DPA: attached a draft DPA (internal markups) — please review and flag anything non-starter.

Thanks — I’ll loop security on any follow-ups.

- Alex
Alex Turner
Head of Security, MaplePay
alex.turner@maplepay.com | +1 (617) 555-0199

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@maplepay.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-19T13:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: MaplePay security qualification & evidence next steps

Alex — quick technical answers to your items and proposed acceptance criteria. Quoting your note above.

Audit logs / retention:
- Redwood supports immutable retention by leveraging cloud-object lock (S3 WORM) plus write-once access controls. For on-prem deployments we offer an HSM-backed signing option for audit log blocks.
- We will provide: sample audit log export (produced as JSON lines) + verification script to validate integrity (sha256) — attachment: auditlog-sample.json.
- Acceptance criteria: sample demonstrates 7-year retention metadata and integrity verification (sha256 chain) + instructions to configure lifecycle/WORM.

Pen test windows / remediation:
- We can support Nov 8–12 as a pen test window. 
- Primary remediation lead: Jordan Blake (redwood-se@redwood.com) — for critical findings we target a 30-day SLA; for high findings 60 days. We will run a joint triage call within 48 hours of receipt of a prioritized findings list.

Controls mapping / SOC 2:
- We will expand the controls matrix Irene attached to include sample artifact IDs so you can reference exact artifacts during procurement.

Let me know if you want a short runbook for evidence delivery (we can auto-generate a zip of requested artifacts once requirements are signed off).

Jordan Blake
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com

Alex — great, thanks for the DPA draft and the timeline options. Confirming next steps and owners so we can update our internal trackers: 

Action items (final):
- Redwood (Irene) — Finalize SOC 2 controls mapping with artifact IDs and deliver updated spreadsheet — due 2026-10-25. (attachment: soc2-controls-matrix.xlsx)
- Redwood (Jordan) — Share audit log sample + integrity verification script and short config doc for S3 WORM/HSM option — due 2026-10-21. (attachment: auditlog-sample.json)
- Redwood (Aditya) — Coordinate procurement timelines and internal commercial approvals (pricing/commit) — initial update by 2026-10-23.
- MaplePay (Alex/security) — Return DPA comments by 2026-10-22; confirm preferred pen test window (we tentatively book Nov 8–12)
- Follow-up: 30-minute call to review controls matrix + DPA — propose Tue, 2026-10-26 10:00 AM PT. Please accept or propose alternate.

If that all looks good I’ll update the HubSpot deal and send calendar invite for the follow-up. Appreciate the quick turnaround from your legal/security teams.

Best,
Irene
